name: mira-vscode
description: Open-source coding agent — read code, edit files, run commands, and delegate to subagents, all with the model you choose.

chatParticipants.name: mira
chatParticipants.description: Ask Mira to read code, run commands, edit files, or delegate to a subagent.

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Start a fresh chat session (drops in-memory history).

commands.name: mode
commands.description: Set the permission mode: plan | manual | auto | edit | yolo.

commands.name: model
commands.description: Hot-swap the model for the next turn.

mira.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the running `mira serve` instance. Loopback by default; change if you're tunnelling to a remote host.

mira.showToolCalls.description: Render each tool call the model makes (name + short arg summary + result). Turn off to see only the model's prose.

mira.followActiveFolder.description: Point the Mira session at whichever workspace folder VS Code has open. Uses PUT /api/cwd on each chat request when the folder changes.

commands.title: Mira: Open Web UI in Browser
